evidence: skills/meta-setup/SKILL.md:311,323 instructs the install agent to write Stop/Notification hook entries to `~/.claude/settings.json` with `command: "bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/de-play-sound.sh ..."`. Anthropic docs (canonical-docs/hooks-doc.md, plugins-reference-doc.md) explicitly state ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} only resolves inside the plugin's `hooks/hooks.json`, not in settings.json. Plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers session_dep_summary.py for Stop but does NOT register de-play-sound.sh. Live error reported by the user during real session: 'Stop hook error: Failed to run: Hook command references ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} but the hook is not associated with a plugin. This variable is only available in hooks defined in a plugin's hooks/hooks.json file, not in settings.json.'
why_it_matters: Sound notifications are 100% broken for everyone who installed v4.1.0+. The same install path may also affect future hook additions written to settings.json. The mute toggle (`/design-engineer:mute-unmute-sound`) is irrelevant when sounds never play in the first place.
direction: Move sound hook registration from skills/meta-setup/SKILL.md install path INTO plugin's hooks/hooks.json (Stop event for completion sound, Notification event for attention sound). Use the existing `~/.claude/de-sound-muted` flag-file mechanism (already implemented in de-play-sound.sh) for opt-in/out instead of writing to settings.json. Remove lines 274, 311, 323 from meta-setup/SKILL.md and the corresponding install question. Update commands/design-engineer/mute-unmute-sound.md to remove 'wired through ~/.claude/settings.json' wording. CHANGELOG entry for next version explaining the fix.

direction: Add `disable-model-invocation: true` to advisor.md frontmatter (or confirm intentional default by adding a comment).

evidence: Frontmatter lacks both disable-model-invocation and effort. advisor is explicitly a manual checkpoint primitive (per CLAUDE.md and Anthropic's advisor-tool docs). Default disable-model-invocation:false allows Claude to auto-invoke at any moment.

evidence: Agent has multiple required Read steps before any implementation can proceed (gallery, prototype, design references, CLAUDE.md). direction: Verify each pre-flight Read fires deterministically; if not, add explicit blocking via PreToolUse hook keyed on the agent's first Write attempt.

evidence: 3 skills teach frameworks but don't provide templates: ux-assumptions (no assumptions template), ux-business-plan (no business model canvas example), ux-mvp-requirements (no MVP criteria checklist)
why_it_matters: Users must invent their own templates; slows down workflows
direction: Create reference files: assumptions-template.md, business-model-canvas-example.md, mvp-criteria-checklist.md

evidence: No case study or real-world example reference files documenting the principle in action
why_it_matters: Psychological principles are abstract; concrete examples make them actionable
direction: Create case-study reference files for each psych-* skill (14 files total)

evidence: Skill coordinates 20+ ux-* skills but doesn't document a master checklist or dependency matrix showing which skills to run in different scenarios
why_it_matters: Users don't know optimal subset to run; may run too many or too few skills
direction: Add a Skill Orchestration Matrix section showing: MVP (minimal set), Growth (expanded set), Mature Product (full review)

evidence: Coordinates all 14 psych-* skills but lacks guidance on running subsets for different project types
why_it_matters: Users may run unnecessary skills; wastes time and creates output fatigue
direction: Add guidance: full scan (all 14) vs. quick-scan (8 core principles) vs. custom (user selects)

evidence: 9 of 10 agents use Title Case for major section headings (e.g., 'Pre-Flight Checks', 'Tool Usage'). CLAUDE.md rule #2 requires sentence case.
why_it_matters: Agent headings are model-facing context; Title Case may bias the model toward Title Case in its own output, violating rule #2 cascadingly.
direction: Convert agent headings to sentence case across all 10 agents.

evidence: Agent references project-local files (gallery, prototype, design refs) without distinguishing required vs optional reads. Calling skills don't know what to brief.
why_it_matters: Sub-agents don't auto-inherit context; ambiguity here causes silent failures.
direction: Add explicit 'Required pre-reads' vs 'Optional pre-reads' sections.

evidence: Both lack `argument-hint:` field. Other 7 commands have it (some empty string).
why_it_matters: Inconsistent frontmatter; argument-hint is the canonical autocomplete hint per docs.
direction: Add `argument-hint: ''` (or omit consistently) to both.

evidence: detect-state.sh missing `set -euo pipefail`. detect-environment.sh and init-project-structure.sh both have it.
why_it_matters: Inconsistent error handling; silent failures possible.
direction: Add `set -euo pipefail` to detect-state.sh.

evidence: v4.7.0 plan still in plans/ root; CLAUDE.md plan workflow mandates archival to plans/archive/ on completion. v4.7.0 was committed in af3e8db.
why_it_matters: Stale plans in the active directory pollute future plan-mode sessions (which scan plans/ for context). Process discipline matters for trust in the plan-mode workflow.
direction: Move plans/2026-04-26-existing-project-support.md to plans/archive/2026-04-26-existing-project-support.md.

evidence: Description and body use em dashes (—) at lines 3, 22, 60. Plugin CLAUDE.md rule #1 explicitly forbids em dashes.
why_it_matters: Self-violation undermines the rule for everyone else and the model. Style consistency matters for credibility.
direction: Replace each em dash with a regular hyphen-minus (-) or restructure the sentence.

evidence: Frontmatter includes optional: [playwright-cli] nested under compatibility (lines 8–10). This is non-canonical; other skills use flat string descriptions. Current structure: compatibility with nested optional object; canonical: compatibility as plain text string.
why_it_matters: Inconsistent structure makes it harder for tooling to parse compatibility declarations uniformly across all skills.
direction: Normalize to canonical format: compatibility: 'Requires Playwright CLI (optional; skill falls back to URL list if absent)' as plain string.

evidence: Reference material paths use variable substitution inconsistently (some use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, some use relative paths from project root).
why_it_matters: Inconsistent path style makes maintenance harder; one of the styles will eventually break.
direction: Choose one canonical path style (likely ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}-relative for plugin assets) and apply consistently.

evidence: meta-document skill auto-invocation timing in dev.md is unclear.
why_it_matters: Inconsistent invocation means living documents may be stale or over-updated.
direction: Define one rule: invoke meta-document at end of every phase (consistent with /design-engineer:document command's role).

evidence: Defensive Read pattern (test -f before Read) is documented in CLAUDE.md but not in the agent body.
why_it_matters: An agent author updating compound-documenter without reading CLAUDE.md may miss the defensive-read rule.
direction: Add defensive read pattern note to compound-documenter.md body referencing CLAUDE.md memory section.

evidence: Plugin bundles playwright MCP server but no skill or agent references mcp__plugin_design-engineer_playwright__*. dev-prototyping uses Playwright via Bash.
why_it_matters: Bundling unused MCP costs install time for no benefit.
direction: Either use playwright MCP in dev-prototyping/audit branch, OR drop from plugin.json.

evidence: Line 152: 'The generated CLAUDE.md MUST include...' uses imperative tone (MUST). Violates gentle advisory tone of CLAUDE.md writing.
why_it_matters: Tone consistency; imperative tone contradicts the plugin's advisory guidelines.
direction: Rephrase: 'The generated CLAUDE.md should include...' or 'Every generated CLAUDE.md includes...' (softer, advisory).

evidence: References WCAG 2.1 AA as the standard. WCAG 2.2 was released in 2023; 2.1 is now outdated (though still valid).
why_it_matters: Not urgent, but the skill should reference current standards to avoid looking stale.
direction: Update references from WCAG 2.1 AA to WCAG 2.2 AA where applicable.

evidence: Agent body launches into role description without 1-line preamble explaining 'when this agent is invoked, here's the bargain'.
why_it_matters: Minor clarity gap.
direction: Add 1-line preamble at top of body describing invocation contract.

evidence: Plugin uses 6 of 28 canonical hook events (UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostCompact, Stop). No SessionStart, no Notification, no SubagentStart/Stop.
why_it_matters: Notification event would be a more semantically correct trigger for the attention sound (currently designed but broken via F-0010); SubagentStop could improve session_dep_summary timing.
direction: Phase post-fix-of-F-0010: register attention sound on Notification event, not Stop.

evidence: detect-state.sh is documented in skills/meta-setup/SKILL.md but never invoked from any skill, agent, command, or hook (verified via reference graph in 02-reference-graph.md).
why_it_matters: Dead-end script clutters scripts/ and confuses future maintainers.
direction: Either wire detect-state.sh into a skill flow or delete it.

evidence: Some scripts in skills/meta-setup/scripts/ may lack the executable bit.
why_it_matters: Scripts invoked via `bash <path>` work without +x, but invoked via `<path>` directly fail.
direction: Run `chmod +x skills/meta-setup/scripts/*.sh hooks/*.sh hooks/*.js`.
